tasks.title: Gate C — intake refuses off-board keys
tasks.objective: Make intake refuse a roadmap key that is not on the board. activation_state returns absent|blocked|activate|done; intake refuses only 'blocked' today. Add a refusal for 'absent' whose error names `roadmap add --no-spec`. The on-roadmap paths (activate/done) and the blocked path are unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: intake.py refuses a key that is not on plans/roadmap.json (activation_state 'absent'), and the error text names `roadmap add --no-spec`.
An on-board key (activate/done) and a blocked key behave exactly as before.
verify_commands: uv run --with pytest python -m pytest factory/tests/test_gates.py -q -k "intake or off_board or absent"
tasks.reviewer_focus: Only 'absent' newly refuses; blocked/activate/done paths untouched; error names the ad-hoc path; no regression to existing intake tests.

tasks.title: Gate A — PR-ticket required check
tasks.objective: Add factory/scripts/check_pr_ticket.py + .github/workflows/pr-ticket-check.yml. The script takes the base..HEAD diff, the head branch, and the PR body and asserts exactly ONE work record resolves: branch feat/<key>-* or a `Ticket: <key|window-id>` line; for a story the key is on roadmap.json and the diff flips it to done with .factory/history/<key>/ added; for a window its ledger done record is in the diff. Non-zero exit fails the required check.
acceptance_criteria: check_pr_ticket.py exits 0 for a well-formed story PR fixture (branch feat/<key>-*, roadmap done-flip + .factory/history/<key>/ in the diff).
It exits non-zero when there is no resolvable ticket, when the done-flip or history is missing, or when two distinct work records resolve.
A window-PR (Ticket: <window-id> + its ledger done record in the diff) passes.
The check is deterministic — pure over its inputs, no network.
verify_commands: uv run --with pytest python -m pytest factory/tests/test_gates.py -q -k "pr_ticket or gate_a"
tasks.reviewer_focus: Exactly-one-record; story requires done-flip + history in the SAME diff; window-id path viable; deterministic (fixtures, no network); the workflow self-tests on this PR.

tasks.title: Gate B — branch auto-link + red-main invariant
tasks.objective: Add factory/scripts/check_board_complete.py (main invariant: every 'done' story in roadmap.json has a pr-linked event in events.jsonl + an outcome or predates_outcome_contract + a .factory/history/<key>/ dir) + .github/workflows/pr-link.yml (pull_request: run `forge pr-link <key> <PR#>`, commit the pr-linked event to the branch, loop-guarded so it does not re-trigger) + board-invariant.yml (runs the check on main). Note both gates in WORKFLOW.md's gating model.
acceptance_criteria: check_board_complete.py exits 0 for a complete board (every done story has a pr-linked event + outcome + history dir).
It exits non-zero when a done story lacks a pr-linked event, an outcome, or a history dir.
A done story carrying predates_outcome_contract passes without an outcome or link.
pr-link.yml commits the pr-linked event to the PR branch (not main) and is guarded to no-op when the link already exists.
verify_commands: uv run --with pytest python -m pytest factory/tests/test_gates.py -q -k "board_complete or gate_b"
tasks.reviewer_focus: predates_outcome_contract exemption honored; check is deterministic; NO CI-to-main writes (link committed to the branch); loop guard present; WORKFLOW.md gating model updated.
